answer_1.quote: The primary objective of role-playing agents is to provide users with immersive conversations by authentically simulate characters.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses for role-playing agents to simulate characters and advance plots.

answer_2.quote: Empirically, our method achieves an improvement of 10.8%, 10.5% / 8.5%, 7.2% in accuracy and F1 score in determining plot-progression moments on Chinese / English characters respectively.

answer_3.quote: we instruct GPT-4o with these criteria ... and employ it as the judgement model, if an RPA's character responses meet any of these criteria for three consecutive rounds, the interaction terminates
methods: conversation termination judgment based on disengagement criteria
criteria: Repetitions between the RPA's current and history replies
Ignorance of user's requests to advance the storyline / deepen relationships
Contradictions in RPA's present and previous messages
Disregard for changes in user emotions
